card.name: Rounding doses to nearest strength
card.fires_on: Words about rounding a dose to a practical amount, such as "rounded", "closest", "odd" or "available", just before "to the nearest" or "number". It appears in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Rounded wording
modes.description: The word rounded (or to) right before "to the nearest" a dose unit.
modes.example: with doses<< rounded>> to the nearest prefilled syringe according

modes.label: Closest or nearest unit
modes.description: A word ending the phrase about the closest dose, strength or cartridge that can be given.
modes.example: Round the total weekly dose (mg) to the closest<< cartridge>> dose while also considering treatment goals and clinical

card.writes: It pushes toward number-related words such as "numbers" and "numer", fitting talk of rounding numbers.
card.plain: It lights up when a label says to round a dose to the nearest available amount.
